summary.en: Israeli air forces have intensified strikes in Lebanon, hitting Hezbollah rockets, launchers in the Beqaa Valley and targets in eastern Lebanon. Hezbollah’s leader again demanded the release of five detained operatives and rejected any post-UNIFIL force outside U.N. authority, while Iran’s support for Hezbollah was reaffirmed. The two sides are preparing for an eighth round of peace talks before year-end. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Det israelske luftforsvaret har økt angrepene i Libanon, og har truffet Hezbollah-raketter, avfyringssteder i Bekaa-dalen og mål i Øst-Libanon. Hezbollah-lederen krevde igjen løslatelse av fem fengslede operatører og avviste enhver styrke etter UNIFIL utenfor FN-myndighet, mens Irans støtte til Hezbollah ble bekreftet. De to partene forbereder en åttende runde fredsforhandlinger før årsskiftet. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
